newsitem.title: USA: Sears gives tire advertising contract to O&M.
newsitem.headline: Sears gives tire advertising contract to O&M.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co said Friday it will consolidate advertising for its entire tire group with the agency Ogilvy & Mather.
The account is estimated at $20 to $30 million, industry sources said.

O&M currently holds the account for the Sears Auto Centers which are located off shopping malls. The consolidation adds the Tire America and National Tire Warehouse stand-alone stores, accounts previously held by Barkley & Evergreen of Kansas City.
The Sears tire group consists of 779 Auto Centers, 150 National Tire stores and 125 Tire America stores.
Sears said it plans to expand its tire business, adding 400 new stores over the next five years, and that advertising will play a key role in the plan's success.
